api_source.description: FunnAI's burn data comes from their protocol API, which aggregates 740+ mAIner canisters. Individual mAIner canisters don't expose cycle balances publicly, but their protocol tracks and reports accurate aggregate burn rates.
api_source.details: The mAIner network uses Proof-of-AI-Work (PoAIW) where AI agents compete to solve challenges. Cycle consumption happens across LLM inference canisters, but the complex cycle flows (top-ups, work payments, rewards) make per-canister tracking inaccurate. The protocol's API provides the true daily burn rate.
